audit.name: V3 phase 1 independent procedural geometry and visual audit
audit.scope: read-only visual, geometry, interaction, performance evidence and test-evidence audit

environment.hardwareGpuCaveat: SwiftShader FPS must not be represented as ordinary hardware GPU performance.

issues.title: Narrow layout hides almost the entire model and removes key camera presets
issues.qualityImpact: At 390px the two 184px panels consume 368px, leaving the 3D view practically unusable; key presets are hidden.
issues.risk: medium: responsive state and touch gestures can conflict with canvas controls
issues.acceptance: At 390x844 the model remains clearly visible with about 50% usable width, both panels can be opened and closed, all six presets remain reachable, and no overflow or touch conflict occurs.

issues.title: Flow toggle is barely perceptible in X-Ray
issues.qualityImpact: Lubrication, coolant and intake paths cannot be followed reliably and the toggle appears ineffective.
issues.risk: medium: emissive overlays and depth changes can flatten the X-Ray view or add draw calls
issues.acceptance: All three path families are continuously traceable with clear direction in X-Ray and section views, on/off screenshots differ perceptually, the legend matches, and performance stays within budget.

issues.title: Front fan and water pump lack a continuous crank-driven accessory path
issues.qualityImpact: The front accessories look disconnected or floating and do not explain their mechanical drive relationship.
issues.risk: low-medium: belt intersections and incorrect rotation ratios
issues.acceptance: A continuous non-intersecting belt connects crank, water-pump and fan pulleys; any animated directions and ratios are mechanically consistent.

issues.title: Block and head remain dominated by rounded-box masses
issues.qualityImpact: Detailed internals contrast with a comparatively generic cast exterior, limiting the quality ceiling.
issues.risk: medium: extra intersections, clipping fragments and draw calls
issues.acceptance: Side and isometric views show mechanically explained bearing bosses, flanges, fastener lands and casting reliefs without obscuring internals or exceeding the performance budget.

issues.title: Top camera crops major systems and lacks UI-safe framing
issues.qualityImpact: The preset fails to provide a complete top-layout overview of intake, exhaust, turbo and fan.
issues.risk: low: possible excess whitespace on other aspect ratios
issues.acceptance: After transition the engine bounds fit between panels with 8-10% margin and no major intake, exhaust, turbo or fan cropping at both 1280x720 and 1600x1000.

issues.title: Selection feedback uses a large empty-space AABB and inspector content is easy to miss
issues.qualityImpact: The highlight feels like a debug box and the live state sits below an invisible-scroll panel.
issues.risk: medium: mesh outline solutions can conflict with transparency and clipping
issues.acceptance: Five representative parts receive geometry-conforming feedback without spanning empty volumes, and all five inspector sections are visible or have an obvious scroll/more affordance at 1280x720.

issues.title: Section view lacks cut caps or hatch materials
issues.qualityImpact: Clipped shells read as hollow and ancillary fragments weaken engineering-section credibility.
issues.risk: high: stencil, transparency, shadow and draw-call complexity
issues.acceptance: Cut block, head and pan faces have consistent cap or hatch treatment, no floating clipping fragments remain, the four-cylinder motion chain stays visible, and performance is remeasured.

issues.title: Dark accessories and crank details merge with the background
issues.qualityImpact: Existing geometry is harder to identify and material hierarchy collapses in shadowed regions.
issues.risk: medium: losing the dark industrial look or overexposing polished metal
issues.acceptance: Grayscale captures preserve clear silhouettes for fan, pulley, sump and crank counterweights in all three modes while flywheel and turbo highlights remain controlled.

issues.title: High draw-call count with no instanced draws leaves limited low-end headroom
issues.qualityImpact: SwiftShader averages only 12.52 fps and 377.04 calls/frame suggests risk on integrated GPUs or high-resolution displays.
issues.risk: medium: instancing complicates picking, highlighting and mode-specific material state
issues.acceptance: Solid view is at or below 220 calls/frame, hardware GPU results identify GPU and resolution and reach at least 45 fps at 1080p, SwiftShader remains separately reported, and picking/modes still pass.

issues.title: Tests verify control state more than visible quality and artifact tests pollute discovery
issues.qualityImpact: A visually cropped or unreadable result can still pass, and reported test count changes with audit artifacts.
issues.risk: low-medium: pixel assertions can vary across GPUs
issues.acceptance: Vitest discovery is scoped to tests/**/*.test.ts; test count is stable with artifact tests present; browser assertions cover settled model bounds, narrow usable canvas, visible flow difference and a dedicated exploded screenshot.

issues.title: Labels cluster around turbo/exhaust and can outlive clipped geometry
issues.qualityImpact: Localized clutter and section-mode semantic mismatch reduce teaching focus without blocking use.
issues.risk: medium: automatic collision avoidance can jitter
issues.acceptance: At all six settled presets labels do not overlap, leaders avoid core parts, clipped parts lose their labels, and minor camera motion does not cause visible jitter.

rankedCandidates.reason: highest visible gain per unit cost
small lighting/material changes benefit several views
removes debug-like selection feedback at modest cost
very high usability gain with medium responsive-layout cost
very high teaching gain with moderate rendering risk
clear mechanical credibility improvement with bounded geometry scope
low-cost protection against future visual regressions
performance upside is substantial but integration risk is higher
quality-ceiling improvement with broad geometry impact
large section-view gain but highest implementation risk
polish item after structural and readability issues

highYieldJudgement.recommendation: Do not close V3 visual quality yet; implement the top-camera, dark-hierarchy and selection-feedback quick wins, then choose one or two bounded medium-cost items before independent revalidation.
